def is_costas(perm):
    n = len(perm)
    vectors = set()
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            dr = perm[j] - perm[i]
            dc = j - i
            if (dr, dc) in vectors:

            vectors.add((dr, dc))
    return True

def find_costas(n):
    # Use backtracking with constraint propagation
    used_rows = [False] * n
    # Store all displacement vectors seen so far
    vectors = set()
    
    def backtrack(col, perm):
        if col == n:
            return perm[:]
        
        for row in range(n):
            if used_rows[row]:
                continue
            
            # Check if adding this position creates any duplicate vectors
            valid = True
            new_vectors = []
            for prev_col in range(col):
                prev_row = perm[prev_col]
                dr = row - prev_row
                dc = col - prev_col
                if (dr, dc) in vectors:
                    valid = False
                    break
                new_vectors.append((dr, dc))
            
            if not valid:
                continue
            
            # Place the mark
            used_rows[row] = True
            for v in new_vectors:
                vectors.add(v)
            perm.append(row)
            
            result = backtrack(col + 1, perm)
            if result:
                return result
            
            # Backtrack
            perm.pop()
            for v in new_vectors:
                vectors.remove(v)
            used_rows[row] = False
        
        return None
    
    return backtrack(0, [])

def verify_costas(perm):
